newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad to attend Tehran Islamic summit.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad to attend Tehran Islamic summit.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on Sunday accepted an invitation attend a summit of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference due to be held in Tehran in December, Assad's spokesman said.

Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani invited Assad to the summit in a message handed to the Syrian president by Iran's Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati in Damascus on Sunday.
"President Assad gave Velayati a reply message containing his acceptance of the invitation," Kourieh said.
